referenceFunction.generalComment: Air emissions from the wood are not accounted for because the same emissions would occur if the wood would not be used. Data on the energy use are specific for the Lang-Sägewerk AG, which delivers the sawn timber to Walter Küng AG for the production of holzpur elements.; UUID: 6e204d54-a41a-3a31-ac4a-1e7b59c8e28b
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Includes drying of wet sawn timber (u=70%) by air (down to u=18-20%) and kiln (down to u=6%) at sawmill. Shrinkage of wood is taken into account. No transports are considered since drying occurs at the sawmill site.
